note: Guided tour of the SK-3X1 viewer (Tour button). Cameras in model feet (x east, y north, z up), matched to the Blender cameras in blender/pro_look.py; lens in mm on a 36 mm sensor. show = a viewer view key whose layers are shown; add / hide = extra layers. Captions are typical, not engineered.

stops.title: A 3x1 gas power campus
stops.eq: Three H-class gas turbines, three HRSGs and stacks, one steam turbine, an 80-cell air-cooled condenser
stops.sys: 230 kV breaker-and-a-half switchyard; modular power, BESS, carbon capture, LNG, hydrogen and a behind-the-meter data centre
stops.cab: 19,728 cables in the model's cable schedule

stops.title: Sixteen zones, one cable network
stops.eq: Switchyard · BESS · reel staging and prefab · admin and control · e-houses · HRSGs · turbine hall · GT inlets · MCC / VFD rooms · modular yard · ACC · chillers and cooling towers · water treatment · carbon capture · gas metering · cable corridor
stops.sys: Every zone is a different electrical environment: heat, vibration, hazardous gas, water, DC
stops.cab: Tray, duct bank, trench and conduit tie the zones together

stops.title: Gas turbine and generator
stops.eq: H-class gas turbine and hydrogen-cooled generator on the EL 20 turbine deck
stops.sys: The generator makes power at about 21 kV (typical for this class)
stops.cab: Instrument, control and lube-oil skid cables drop from the overhead tray to the skids

stops.title: Isolated-phase bus to the step-up transformer
stops.eq: Isolated-phase bus, generator circuit breaker, unit auxiliary transformer tap, GSU
stops.sys: About 11 kA per phase at 21 kV leaves the generator; the GSU steps it up to 230 kV
stops.cab: No cable on the main path: at these currents it is bus duct. Cable starts at the taps

stops.title: Generator step-up transformers
stops.eq: Three 21/230 kV GSUs with firewalls, HV bushings, surge arresters, take-off gantries
stops.sys: Each unit's generator is stepped up to 230 kV and taken overhead to the switchyard
stops.cab: CT, alarm and cooling-control cable in Type TC-ER; deluge fire-protection wiring; MV-105 to the unit transformers

stops.title: Gas-turbine air inlet
stops.eq: Three inlet filter houses on their own frames, stair towers, hoist landings
stops.sys: Clean air is the turbine's fuel partner: filter pulse cleaning, anti-icing and chilling are electrical loads
stops.cab: Type TC-ER power and control to the pulse-cleaning compressors, heaters and differential-pressure instruments

stops.title: 230 kV breaker-and-a-half switchyard
stops.eq: Circuit breakers, disconnects, CTs and VTs, line take-off gantries
stops.sys: Two breakers per circuit: any breaker can be maintained without an outage
stops.cab: CT / VT and breaker control cable in trench to the relay house; ACSR overhead conductor to the utility

stops.title: 230 kV XLPE cable termination
stops.eq: Outdoor sealing ends, surge arresters, cleated risers, bonding link box
stops.sys: An underground high-voltage link between the yard and a transformer bay
stops.cab: HV XLPE 230 kV, 1/C 2500 kcmil Cu, copper wire screen, aluminium laminate sheath

stops.title: R1: 13.8 kV and 4.16 kV switchgear
stops.eq: Metal-clad switchgear lineups across the operating aisle, MCCs, protection and control panels
stops.sys: The plant runs on its own power: unit auxiliary transformers feed 13.8 kV, then 4.16 kV and 480 V
stops.cab: MV-105 15 kV and 5 kV to motors and transformers; Type TC-ER 600 V power and control

stops.title: R4: the air-cooled condenser fan drives
stops.eq: Two lineups of variable-frequency drives, output trays overhead
stops.sys: One 480 V drive per fan, 80 fans on the air-cooled condenser
stops.cab: VFD cable: three symmetrical grounds and an overall shield, to contain common-mode noise

stops.title: The air-cooled condenser
stops.eq: 80 fan cells on a raised deck, steam ducts and street risers, wind wall, stair towers
stops.sys: Dry cooling: the steam turbine exhaust is condensed by air, so the plant needs no cooling-tower water
stops.cab: VFD cable from the R4 drives to every fan motor, up the street risers in tray

stops.title: Inlet-chilling plant and its cooling tower
stops.eq: Chiller building, chilled-water pumps and e-house, the cooling tower and the TES tank
stops.sys: Chilled inlet air recovers gas-turbine output on hot days
stops.cab: MV-105 to the chillers; VFD cable to the tower fans; Type TC-ER to the pumps

stops.title: The legend on every jacket
stops.eq: Ladder tray stack over GT1, segregated by voltage class
stops.sys: 13.8 kV feeders and 600 V power, with control and instrumentation in their own trays
stops.cab: ARMOR-X MC-HL and MV-105: the printed legend is how inspectors verify the cable

stops.title: From R1 to the turbine hall
stops.eq: Outdoor medium-voltage tray, HRSG 1 and its stack ahead
stops.sys: Medium-voltage feeders to the gas-turbine auxiliaries
stops.cab: ARMOR-X MC-HL (continuous corrugated aluminium armor) beside MV-105

stops.title: Underground: duct banks and manholes
stops.eq: MV and LV duct banks, manholes and the cable trench, with the ground removed
stops.sys: Concrete-encased conduit protects the cable and lets it be pulled again later
stops.cab: MV-105 and Type TC-ER in duct, pulled manhole to manhole

stops.title: Building a duct bank
stops.eq: Open trench over the 13.8 kV collector bank: trench box, excavator, crew
stops.sys: Conduits are laid, spaced and encased in concrete before the cable is pulled
stops.cab: MV-105 15 kV collector circuits in the modular yard

stops.title: Cable X-ray: every cable on its route
stops.eq: Every run of the cable schedule on its modelled path: tray, duct bank, trench
stops.sys: Coloured by class: HV, MV, 600 V, control, instrumentation, fire alarm, fibre
stops.cab: About 1,120 miles of cable; instrumentation is the largest share

stops.title: The cable reel yard
stops.eq: Reel rows, payoffs and reel rollers, the SIMpull Truck unloading reels
stops.sys: Reels staged by circuit and pull sequence so crews never wait for cable
stops.cab: SIMpull reels on cradles, 45K / 30K reel rollers, JAX stands

stops.title: Prefab staging bay
stops.eq: Cable spine modules on dunnage, one on the flatbed, pre-terminated MV crates, conduit racks
stops.sys: Cable installed and tested in the yard, then set in place like equipment
stops.cab: Pre-terminated MV-105 assemblies and pre-pulled tray modules

stops.title: The prefab cable spine going in
stops.eq: Spine module 5 on the crane over its bents, modules 1 to 4 already set from MOD-EH
stops.sys: Weeks of field pulling replaced by a crane lift and a splice
stops.cab: Factory-terminated MV-105 tails spliced at each module joint

stops.title: HRSG 1: from the e-house to the marshalling box
stops.eq: HRSG casing, EL 42 control and instrument tray, marshalling box
stops.sys: Hundreds of transmitters, valves and thermocouples per HRSG, marshalled locally
stops.cab: Instrumentation PLTC / TC-ER shielded pairs, thermocouple extension, RTD triads

stops.title: The main control room
stops.eq: Six-position operator console facing the video wall
stops.sys: The distributed control system: every signal on the campus ends here
stops.cab: Single-mode armored fibre between buildings; FPLR fire-alarm cable (red jacket)

stops.title: The gas yard: Class I, Division 2
stops.eq: Metering, regulation, performance heater, filter-separators
stops.sys: Fuel gas makes this a classified area: every entry is sealed
stops.cab: Rigid conduit with EYS seals, and ARMOR-X MC-HL run exposed on strut

stops.title: LNG: one rack, into the e-house roof
stops.eq: LNG e-house, MC-HL rack to the send-out pumps, reel roller, sheave, capstan
stops.sys: Send-out pump power and controls, with a roof entry into the e-house
stops.cab: ARMOR-X MC-HL pulled from the reel; intrinsically safe instrument cable (blue jacket)

stops.title: The LNG import terminal
stops.eq: 160,000 m3 full-containment tank, open-rack vaporizers, HP send-out pumps, boil-off compressors, 1,700 ft jetty and berth
stops.sys: Imported LNG is vaporized and sent to the plant's M&R by buried pipeline; the terminal takes power from the plant switchyard
stops.cab: 230 kV XLPE from the switchyard to the terminal substation; MV-105 to the send-out and seawater pumps in the cable trench

stops.title: The modular power yard
stops.eq: RICE engine hall, simple-cycle units, aeroderivatives, fuel cells, microturbines, the PCM and MOD-EH
stops.sys: Fast-start capacity on its own 13.8 kV collector, beside the combined cycle
stops.cab: MV-105 15 kV collector feeders in tray and duct bank to MOD-EH

stops.title: RICE engine hall
stops.eq: Eight 18-cylinder gas engines in one hall: exhaust trains, SCRs, 90 ft stacks, radiators
stops.sys: Reciprocating engine-generators: fast start, high part-load efficiency, little water
stops.cab: MV-105 generator leads; ARMOR-X MC on strut to the radiator fan disconnects

stops.title: RICE generator cables to the PCM
stops.eq: Ladder-tray bridge from the engine hall to the power control module, crew dressing the cables
stops.sys: 13.8 kV generator outputs collected in the PCM switchgear
stops.cab: MV-105 15 kV single conductors in ladder tray, the legend on every jacket

stops.title: Black-start gensets
stops.eq: Two gas gensets with their own switchgear, a battery alternative beside them
stops.sys: Restarting with no grid: the gensets energize the auxiliaries so a gas turbine can start
stops.cab: MV-105 from the genset breakers to the black-start switchgear and on to the station bus

stops.title: Simple-cycle aeroderivative units
stops.eq: Two LM6000-class units: inlet filter house, turbine enclosure, SCR, 80 ft stack
stops.sys: Peaking power in about ten minutes from start; 13.8 kV generators onto the collector
stops.cab: MV-105 generator leads; Type TC-ER control; ARMOR-X MC-HL in the fuel-gas skid

stops.title: Trailer-mounted turbines
stops.eq: TM2500-class mobile aeroderivatives, about 35 MW each: filter house, raised stack, control trailer
stops.sys: Bridge power while the plant is built, or emergency capacity later
stops.cab: MV-105 15 kV generator leads in ground trays to the pad switchgear

stops.title: Containerized gas gensets
stops.eq: Eight 2 MW-class gas gensets in 40 ft containers, generator breakers, the paralleling e-house
stops.sys: 13.8 kV units paralleled in the e-house, then onto the pad switchgear
stops.cab: MV-105 15 kV from each container in ground tray to the paralleling switchgear

stops.title: Trailer genset and its portable feeder
stops.eq: MOB-1 trailer genset, the drive-over cable ramp, the portable input cabinet
stops.sys: Plug-in power: the feeder crosses the road on a ramp, no trench
stops.cab: Type SHD-GC 15 kV portable cable (two grounds and a ground check), through the C-L01 ramp

stops.title: Open-skid and enclosed gensets
stops.eq: GEN-O open engine-generator skid and GEN-E 2 MW enclosed industrial genset
stops.sys: 480 V generators into the PAD-LV paralleling switchboard
stops.cab: Type W 480 V sets with cam-lock plugs; flexible cable rated for vibration and oil

stops.title: The portable power pad
stops.eq: Containerized gas gensets, trailer genset, load bank, pad switchgear
stops.sys: Temporary and rental power plugged in and out in days
stops.cab: Type W 2 kV with cam-lock plugs at 480 V; Type SHD-GC 15 kV portable feeders

stops.title: Type W sets into the paralleling switchboard
stops.eq: PAD-LV paralleling switchboard, cam-lock panel, Type W sets from the gensets
stops.sys: 480 V generator outputs paralleled on the pad
stops.cab: Type W 2 kV single conductors, EPDM / CPE, colour-coded cam-lock plugs

stops.title: Solid-oxide fuel cells
stops.eq: Twelve fuel-cell modules (200 to 300 kW class), inverter / AC cabinet and desulfurizer
stops.sys: Gas to DC electrochemically, then inverters to AC: no combustion, very low NOx
stops.cab: DC from the stacks to the inverter; 600 V Type TC-ER from the AC cabinet to the step-up

stops.title: Microturbines
stops.eq: Six 1 MW microturbines (Capstone C1000 class) in two groups
stops.sys: Small gas turbines with high-speed generators and power electronics; 480 V output
stops.cab: 600 V Type TC-ER power to the 480 V board and the 480 V : 13.8 kV step-up

stops.title: The modular collector
stops.eq: MOD-EH 13.8 kV collector e-house and two 13.8/230 kV step-up transformers
stops.sys: Every modular unit lands on one 13.8 kV bus, stepped up to 230 kV for the switchyard
stops.cab: MV-105 15 kV feeders into MOD-EH; bus duct to the step-ups (about 5,000 A)

stops.title: Battery energy storage
stops.eq: Battery containers, PCS / MV skids, DC trenches, collector feeders
stops.sys: Rides through load steps and supports the grid in seconds
stops.cab: 2 kV DC conductors in the trench; MV-105 35 kV aluminium collector circuits

stops.title: A data-centre campus behind the meter
stops.eq: About 150 MW of IT load: two data halls, rooftop dry coolers, 36 backup gensets, a 40 MW / 80 MWh BESS
stops.sys: Supplied from the modular yard; the grid tie is normally open
stops.cab: 13.8 kV cable bus from MOD-EH to the step-ups; 34.5 kV distribution to the halls

stops.title: Backup diesel gensets
stops.eq: 36 diesel gensets of 3.6 MW (130 MW), paralleling switchgear, two 75 MVA step-ups
stops.sys: Carry the IT load and critical cooling if every other source is lost
stops.cab: MV-105 15 kV genset feeders to the 13.8 kV paralleling switchgear; 35 kV to buses A and B

stops.title: Three ways to power the campus
stops.eq: 13.8 / 34.5 kV step-ups, the 230 kV tie, switchgear and the BTM battery
stops.sys: 1 islanded gensets and battery · 2 from the modular yard · 3 grid tie, normally open
stops.cab: MV-105 35 kV feeders; HV XLPE on the 230 kV tie

stops.title: Carbon capture
stops.eq: Absorbers A to C, strippers, CO2 compression
stops.sys: A large new electrical load: 16 MW-class booster fans per train, compressors
stops.cab: MV-105 to the large drives; HV cable to the carbon-capture transformers

stops.title: Carbon-capture cooling tower
stops.eq: About 30 cells cooling the amine process water
stops.sys: Wet cooling for the capture plant only; the power block stays dry
stops.cab: VFD cable to the fan motors; MV-105 to the circulating-water pumps

stops.title: Green hydrogen
stops.eq: Electrolyzer hall: five PEM skids, rectifiers, DC trays
stops.sys: Rectified DC at the stacks: a different cable problem
stops.cab: DC conductors in tray from the rectifiers to the PEM stacks

stops.title: Every megawatt travels through a cable
stops.eq: One campus, from the gas turbine to the grid and the data centre
stops.sys: Power, control, instrumentation, fire alarm and fibre
stops.cab: About 1,120 miles of cable, mapped on its route
